summary: [NetSuite] rate-limits: Concurrency + frequency governance, account/tier-specific: concurrency pool (~20 typical), per-user RESTlet sublimit (5 concurrent), 60s and 24h windows. REST->429, SOAP->403/faults, RESTlet->400 SSS_REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. Numbers are account-specific: detect and back off, never hardcode.
